notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
New update is available :

* Added double-click function to move the player character instantly to the destination clicked.

* A few reported bugs were fixed.

* Reported funny glitches were fixed.


Thank you for the feedbacks and please keep sending them if you find any issues that bother you.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
The first update is available :

* The game speed increased from 30 to 45 FPS.
* The mouse cursor speed increased.
* Reported bugs were fixed.
* A few untranslated words were corrected.

Thank you for your feedback. Please keep sending them if you find any issues that bother you.
